title: Peasant Movements Kheda Peasant Struggle
definition: The Kheda Satyagraha (1918) was a non-violent agrarian protest led by Mahatma Gandhi and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel against the British colonial government's insistence on full revenue collection despite crop failure in the Kheda district of Gujarat.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the first major 'Peasant Satyagraha' in India, demonstrating the efficacy of Gandhian methods in rural mobilization and the rise of Sardar Patel as a national leader.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Peasant Movements Kheda Peasant Struggle.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
